# `s3` source.json fields

Generated from [`drivers/s3/resources/spec.json`](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/blob/v1.1.2/drivers/s3/resources/spec.json) at `v1.1.2`. The same schema prints with `docker run --rm olakego/source-s3:v1.1.2 spec`.

Nested fields use dots: `ssl.mode` is `"ssl": {"mode": ...}`. *Required* is relative to the parent object: `ssh_config.type` is required only if `ssh_config` is set. A field marked *only when* exists only in that branch of its parent object.

  "bucket_name": "<BUCKET_NAME>",
